acceptance: Each monthly BTS file used at SF1 has a sha256 pinned, and the downloader refuses a mismatch.
The SF1 row count in the spec is re-derived from the pinned files.
context: Found while fixing integrity-validator-false-failures-20261114. Downloading the files is network access but not cloud spend. Guardrails: work in a linked worktree (make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight); never edit the primary clone. Related items share one feature branch and PR where their files overlap. No live-cloud runs and no credentials in Git or logs; heavy work only through lock-taking entry points or make heavy-run after make heavy-status. Follow the comment policy and add a changelog.d fragment for user-facing changes. Re-verify every cited file and line before acting; they are hints. Stop and report rather than widen scope.
description: Problem: downloader_specs.yaml has an empty pinned_source.sha256 for flightdata, so the SF1 row count (23437547 flights) rests on agreement between bundles and a local copy rather than on pinned source hashes. If BTS republishes a month, data and counts can drift silently.
